name: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk
summary: PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates palm plantations in Indonesia and Singapore. It operates in two segments, Plantations and Manufacturing. The company offers palm products, including crude palm oil and palm kernel. As of December 31, 2019, its total planted area was approximately 124,218 hectares in Kalimantan, Sumatera, Sulawesi, and Papua. The company also engages in the palm oil mill and bulking, and investment holding activities. PT Eagle High Plantations Tbk was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in South Jakarta, Indonesia.
